verdict.rationale: A desktop operating system could plausibly include an AI assistant that acts as an MCP client, so this story applies to Fedora Workstation. However, the evidence pack covers only desktop features, package management, containers, VMs and community experiences, with nothing about MCP or agent tool integration. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability is "none".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
